sentences.text:
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.8483 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No.7 of 2025 of Narketpally Police Station, against the petitioner.

2. The petitioner is arrayed as accused in Crime No.7 of 2025 registered for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 419 and 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC').
3.

Heard Mr.K.V.Bhanu Prasad, learned Senior Counsel argued on behalf of Mr.K.Sai Sri Harsha,
learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
4.
Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner respectfully submits that notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023 was not served on petitioner/accused.
Although the petitioner is fully committed to cooperating with the investigative process, he is apprehensive of potential coercive action being taken against him.

It is further submitted that Section 467 IPC would not attract in the circumstances of the case and other offences being punishable with imprisonment upto seven years,
the petitioner has no intention of evading the investigation and are willing to extend full cooperation to the authorities, learned counsel prays that appropriate directions be issued to the concerned police officials to proceed in accordance with law by issuing a notice under Section 35(3) of the BNSS, 2023, thereby safeguarding the petitioner from any unwarranted coercive measures.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor as per his instructions submits that notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023 has been served on the petitioner on 05.06.2025.
6. I have perused the materials on record.

7. Considering the submission of the learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner that the notice has not been served upon the petitioner and except the alleged offence under Section 467 of IPC, rest of the accusations are punishable with an imprisonment upto seven years and the readiness of the petitioner to cooperate with the investigation, without entering into merits and keeping open all prerogatives in the Investigation, the petitioner is hereby directed to appear before the Station Ranjith Kumar Avula Sagar vs The State Of Telangana on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96447988/
1 House Officer (SHO), Narketpally Police Station, within one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
